subject: Pricing tier restructure + Order Form / SOW redline coordination
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@orendahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing tier restructure + Order Form / SOW redline coordination

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our product conversation, we've put together a focused change that moves you from the legacy unit-based rate sheet to a tiered pricing structure (three tiers) and an updated SOW that clarifies burst capacity and data retention. The change keeps your committed baseline the same but reduces marginal cost above Tier 2 — it's intended to preserve predictability while lowering marginal usage costs for peak months.

Attached: OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (summary redlines) and SOW_v2_trackchanges.docx. Highlights:
- Pricing: new Tier 1/2/3 bands, with clear overage rate caps.
- SLA: clarified latency SLO for dedicated endpoints (minimal change to uptime SLA).
- Data retention: two options called out (30 days default / 90 days for regulated workflows) — we flagged the 90-day as opt-in.
- Transition: a 60-day window to migrate usage and pin model versions.

Ask: could you loop in procurement + legal to review the attached redlines? Marissa from our contracts team is cc'd and can iterate on language. If procurement needs a single-sheet justification for finance, we can produce that by EOD Monday.

Timing: I know you mentioned a May 20 start for the expanded pilot billing; a response within two business days on material redlines would keep us on schedule for internal approvals.

Thanks —
Connor
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (summary of redlines), SOW_v2_trackchanges.docx (track changes)

From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@orendahealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@orendahealth.com>, legal@orendahealth.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing tier restructure + Order Form / SOW redline coordination

Connor —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear summary. I’ve looped procurement and our GC (Ben) into this thread. Quick asks from our side before legal takes a deep pass:
- Can you provide a 1-page cost impact example at three volume points (current baseline, projected peek month, 2x baseline)? We need this for our finance review.
- For the data retention options, confirm whether logs/trace data are included in the 30-day default or excluded.
- Are there any changes to the support contact path for incidents under the new SLA language?

We aim to have a preliminary redline back to you by EOD Monday, May 10. If Redwood's internal contract team wants to propose narrow alternative wording for the retention clause, please include it in your next send so we can consider before drafting counter-redlines.

Samantha
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Orenda Health
samantha.cho@orendahealth.com | +1 617-555-2201

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@orendahealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing tier restructure + Order Form / SOW redline coordination

Samantha — Connor —

Thanks for looping me in. I pulled the redlines into a short track-changes doc and annotated the two clauses that usually require legal sign-off: data retention (Section 5) and indemnity carve-outs (we made no changes to indemnity, but noted budgetary language near Section 9 that often triggers GC review).

Summary of what I changed in the attached SOW_v2_trackchanges.docx:
- Consolidated the three-tier pricing table and added a simple example row for baseline and two higher-volume months.
- Added an explicit migration window (60 days) and a statement that model pinning will be honored per Order Form version.
- Proposed option language for retention: default = 30 days (logs excluded); opt-in = 90 days (includes logs and traces).
- Minor edits to SLA definitions to make escalation paths explicit (Support Level 1/2/3 and POC email list).

If Ben/GC prefers different retention wording, we'll accept a counterproposal. I've attached the track-changes doc and a one-page cost-impact example (simple numbers) for your finance team.

Attachments: SOW_v2_trackchanges.docx, Cost_impact_examples_Orenda.pdf

Marissa
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0219

From: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@orendahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@orendahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing tier restructure + Order Form / SOW redline coordination

Marissa / Connor —

Thanks for the draft. Our team reviewed and attached a short counter-redline (Orenda_counterredline.pdf). Primary items from our GC:
1) Retention: we need a guarantee that customer-controlled data (PHI derivatives and de-identified sets used for model tuning) are purged within 90 days unless otherwise agreed in writing. We are ok with a 30-day default for logs, but traces that could reconstruct clinical flows should be 90 days.
2) Liability cap: proposing to tie the cap to the monthly committed spend * 12 for the first 12 months of the agreement, then revert to standard cap; this is to ensure cover for pilot rollouts.
3) Change control: our procurement requests a simple change-control table with estimated approval windows (10 business days for minor SOW changes, 20 business days for pricing changes).

We can accept the migration window and the tier structure in principle, but need the retention and liability items addressed before legal will sign off. Also — please confirm who at Redwood will be the escalation point for security incidents that affect PHI.

Ben Wallace
General Counsel | Orenda Health
ben.wallace@orendahealth.com | +1 617-555-3344

Attachments: Orenda_counterredline.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@orendahealth.com>, Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@orendahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing tier restructure + Order Form / SOW redline coordination

Ben / Samantha —

Thanks for the clear notes — really helpful. Quick responses and next steps: 
- Retention: we propose the following compromise language (we will send a clean Order Form with this language included): "Default retention for customer logs: 30 days. Customer-controlled clinical data and traces intended for model tuning will be retained up to 90 days only with explicit customer opt-in; Redwood will provide an auditable deletion confirmation upon request."
- Liability cap: we can accept a 12x monthly committed spend cap for the first 12 months for this pilot. We'll mark this in the Order Form and include a sunset clause to revert to standard cap thereafter.
- Change control: Marissa will insert a change-control table with the approval windows Ben requested.
- Security incident escalation: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) will be primary escalation contact for security incidents impacting PHI; CC list will include Redwood Security and the customer's security mailbox.

I’ve uploaded the updated OrderForm_v3 (clean) to DocuSign for signature so you can review the integrated language and counters. Link: https://www.docusign.com/packets/xyz-transaction-2027-05. If that looks OK to you and legal is comfortable, we'll route for GC sign-off and execute.

As always — happy to hop on a 20-minute call with your GC if it helps speed alignment.

Connor
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (updated — clean), Note: DocuSign packet above
